summary: John's 3rd great-uncle; eldest brother of Henry J. Meier.
bio: Born 11 Nov 1862 in Germany (three weeks after his parents' wedding); coal-mine laborer at 18; married Anna Wenner 1886; died 1915 Hazleton. Could be the 'Fred. Meier' Democratic conferee of 1893.
